verdict.rationale: The IRS's own pages document online completion of a founder's core transactions. EINs can be applied for through the online assistant, information returns can be e-filed through the IRIS Taxpayer Portal, payments can be made via Direct Pay and EFTPS, and signed forms such as the 83(b) Form 15620 can be completed online through Online Account. These rails have published constraints: the EIN tool keeps limited operating hours, sessions expire after 15 minutes with no save, applicants get 1 EIN per day, and signed online forms require ID.me identity proofing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of completing these flows end to end; around-the-clock availability of the EIN rail; direct online filing of returns beyond IRIS without going through an authorized e-file provider or MeF software.
